label: Applying directly to Universidade Católica Portuguesa, autumn 2027

milestones.label: Apply on predicted grades
milestones.note: Open to any nationality; EU citizens can apply in every round. Offers are conditional on final grades. For the 2026 intake Católica Lisbon ran four rounds from 3 December 2025 to 3 June 2026 plus an extra round to 3 July, and wanted the English certificate by 3 July and final grades by 17 July. The 2027 rounds were not yet published on 24 September 2026.

milestones.label: IB results released
milestones.note: Final results confirm the conditional offer.

notes: Covers Católica Lisbon and the wider Universidade Católica Portuguesa. Only Católica Lisbon's process was read; the other campuses publish a 2026/27 international calendar that did not render its dates to an automated read.
